connectors.name: AniKoto
connectors.releaseNotes: 0.3.13: follows the source's move to anikototv.bz. Adds the new address to the allowed hosts and accepts saved title links from either address. Routes, title matching and audio handling are unchanged from 0.3.12. Measured on 14 Nov 2026 at 36 of 47 available titles (middle episode); spoken language and device playback were not verified.

connectors.name: AniKage (BETA)
connectors.releaseNotes: Handles both opaque source tokens and absolute HTTPS source URLs from the source-owned Anikage response using existing bounded URL transforms. Preserves the existing minimum app version, Koto provider, Sub/Dub mapping, subtitles, headers, and host allowlist. Pending live confirmation; no broad reliability claim.

connectors.name: AnimeGG
connectors.releaseNotes: Declares honest per-episode Sub and Dub availability so unavailable audio is disabled before playback.

connectors.name: Update Flow Test

connectors.name: One Pace

connectors.name: Synthetiq One
connectors.releaseNotes: Retired from new installation because current playback is unreliable. Existing saved data and historical connector releases are retained. Choose another active source; this retirement does not delete downloads or library entries.

connectors.name: Synthetiq Anime

The Niche screen and spoken language were not checked on a device. Requires Aroki 2.1.36 or newer.

connectors.name: AniWorld
connectors.releaseNotes: Owner-approved public availability for Aroki 2.0.36+. Home/Browse discovery and native playback resolver are unchanged. Sub-only: German-subtitle mirror first, English-subtitle fallback; German Dub is not included. Visible captions, spoken language and offline remain unverified.

connectors.name: Anime-Sama
connectors.releaseNotes: 0.3.3-r2 preserves the 2.1.36+ legacy panel-comment opt-in and all identity/stream mappings; repairs Catalogue discovery to use the current source-owned as-carte cards and title/link fields already used by Search.

connectors.name: AniPM (BETA)
connectors.releaseNotes: Playback proceeds only when AniPM declares the requested Sub or Dub availability and matching effective language for the episode. Missing or conflicting declarations fail before session creation. Existing saved titles, episode mapping, request headers, supplied captions, and session-expiry handling are preserved. Requires Aroki 2.1.36 or newer.

connectors.name: KickAssAnime
connectors.releaseNotes: 0.1.2: no resolver change. Corrects the authorization note: this module was first published on 22 Nov 2026 without the owner's authorization; the owner reviewed it and asked to keep it on 26 Nov 2026 after testing. KickAssAnime source (kaa.lt JSON catalogue, krussdomi player). Sub only: the site's HLS master carries several audio tracks (Japanese default plus English and others) and Aroki 2.1.36 cannot choose a track per request, so Dub is not offered. Measured 26 Nov 2026 with the 2.1.36 engine tool: 25 corpus titles, middle episode; 21 reached the HLS playlist and first video segment. The 4 misses were titles the site lists under a different name or has no video for. Not verified: playback on a device, which audio track the device plays, and subtitle timing.

connectors.name: AnimeWorld (SUB ITA)
connectors.releaseNotes: 0.1.1: no resolver change. Corrects the authorization note: this module was first published on 22 Nov 2026 without the owner's authorization; the owner reviewed it and asked to keep it on 26 Nov 2026 after testing. AnimeWorld entries the site lists as SUB ITA (Japanese audio with Italian subtitles) only. ITA dub entries are a separate site entry and are excluded from search; an ITA page lists no episodes, and Dub requests return no stream. Measured 26 Nov 2026 with the 2.1.36 engine tool: 25 entries sampled from the site's A-Z listing, middle episode; 23 reached a valid video file with the sampled title. The 2 failures were Italian-dub-only entries, which this module excludes by design. The site uses Italian, English or romaji titles, so some names are not found. Device playback, subtitle presence and spoken language were not verified.

connectors.name: ToonTales (Classic Cartoons)
connectors.releaseNotes: Retired on 2026-11-26 at the owner's request. No new installations or updates are offered. Existing installed copies and user data are not deleted; you can remove this source on your device and choose another available source.

connectors.name: AnimeUnity (ITA)
connectors.releaseNotes: 0.1.1: no resolver change. Corrects the authorization note: this module was first published on 22 Nov 2026 without the owner's authorization; the owner reviewed it and asked to keep it on 26 Nov 2026 after testing. AnimeUnity Italian anime catalogue. Sub plays the site's JPN version (Japanese audio, normally with Italian subtitles); Dub plays the site's ITA version (Italian audio). The audio version is picked from the site's own per-episode language list and checked again on the episode page, so a Dub request never returns the Japanese version and a Sub request never returns the Italian dub. Known limit: Dub reads only the first entry of that list, so an episode the site lists as JPN first and ITA second offers no Dub stream although the dub exists. Video is HLS from VixCloud. Measured 26 Nov 2026 with the 2.1.36 engine tool, middle episode: 21 of 25 sampled titles played with automatic audio; Dub resolved for 7 of 10 titles the site lists with an Italian version. Italian-only titles play only when Dub is asked. Search uses the site's own titles, so some names are not found. Genres are not shown. Device playback, subtitle presence and spoken language were not verified.
